newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 4.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The local head of Swiss-Swedish power group Asea Brown Boveri, chosen to build a new power station in Ivory Coast, said the project was likely to cost 170 billion CFA francs ($290 million) and it would be operating by January 1999.

- Ivory Coast Red Cross begins a programme of setting up and equipping small clinics in villages that have integrated refugees from Liberia, along Ivory Coast's western border. The project will eventually be spread to the rest of the country.

- World coffee prices have soared, and should stay at the higher levels because reduced crops are expected in the main producer countries. Ivory Coast is to clear all planters from protected forests, which could cut production significantly, since 25 percent of the total comes from these zones.
